At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**What You Will Do**

As the Manager of Accelerated Leadership Development, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of leadership within our organization. You will support the Program Management Leader in the global delivery of impactful development programs for high-potential talent, ensuring alignment with business needs and organizational goals. Your expertise will drive the success of our leadership pipeline and enhance the learner experience.

Program Readiness:

* Support the Program Management Lead in the creation and maintenance of the program management project plan throughout the lifecycle of the program. Track action items and milestones to closure.
* Lead pre-program milestone readiness reviews to confirm participant enrollment, facilitator preparation, materials, technology, and logistics are complete.
* Attend recurring meetings with the program vendor partners and track closure of action items.
* Provide program status updates for weekly reporting and macro plan updates.

Attendee Management:

* Maintain attendee roster data for leadership development program participants
* Track confirmations of leaders requested to join the leadership development program for engagement opportunities. Request and track leader inputs (biographies, dietary restrictions, and availability of preparation meetings).

Data maintenance:

* Maintain organization of program file documentation in the SharePoint repository.

Participant communication:

* Manage the program team mailbox, serving as a primary point of contact for participant questions by responding to inquiries, resolving issues, or escalating to the appropriate point of contact as needed, while ensuring a seamless participant experience.
* Track completion status of participant pre-work actions and follow up to ensure timely closure.

Learning systems:

* Manage architecture of program setup structure in the learning management system.
* Track program attendance and completions.
* Work with Learning Operations team to load attendance data into learning systems.

Post-program follow-through:

* Coordinate post-program participant evaluations, participant follow-up, action items, and program closeout activities.
* Analyze participant evaluation feedback, summarize into top themes, and assist Program Manager with activities to continually improve the program experience and delivery.
* Support the Program Management Lead throughout program after action reviews (AARs) with key sponsors and stakeholders.

Standardization:

* Develop and maintain program playbooks, standard operating procedures, templates, and checklists to ensure consistent delivery across cohorts.

Program session support:

* Support onsite delivery of multi-day program sessions at major program partner locations as needed
* Up to 40% travel

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience **or**an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years of experience **or** in absence of a degree, 12 years of relevant experience

* Experience in project and program management, including developing actionable plans, managing timelines, mitigating risks, engaging stakeholders, and driving measurable outcomes.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities, maintain visibility of critical paths and dependencies, and use data-driven analysis to generate actionable insights.
* Experience supporting accelerated or high-potential talent development programs and delivering executive-level communications and presentations.
* High proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including creating executive-ready presentations, developing visual content, and preparing professional communication materials.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Experience supporting large enterprise-level change or transformation initiatives.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Digital Fraud (Remote)
jobs.description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.  
  
Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.  

**Description**
---------------

Connecting People. Uniting the World. There’s never been a more exciting time to join United Airlines! As a global company that operates in hundreds of locations around the world — with millions of customers and tens of thousands of employees — we have a unique responsibility to uplift and provide opportunities in the places where we work, live and fly.  
  
We’re on a path to becoming the best airline in aviation history. Join our Cybersecurity and Digital Risk (CDR) team to help lead the industry in cyber safety, security and resilience. United's CDR team plays a critical role in protecting our operations by enabling secure and resilient systems, managing threats and vulnerabilities, and ensuring swift response and recovery. Our mission is to seamlessly embed cybersecurity and digital risk management into every aspect of our business. We help drive progress and growth through trusted digital solutions, safeguarding assets and empowering our team, all while promoting a cyber-safe and secure environment that supports resilient airline operations.  
  
United offers a competitive benefits package aimed at keeping you happy, healthy, and well-traveled. From employee-run "Business Resource Group" communities to world-class benefits like parental leave, 401(k), and privileges like space-available travel, United is truly a one-of-a-kind place to work. Are you ready to travel the world and help us keep our airline cyber safe? Apply today!

**Job Overview and Responsibilities**

The Program Mgr, Digital Fraud leads complex, enterprise Digital Fraud programs within Cybersecurity & Digital Risk, translating fraud strategy into coordinated roadmaps, funded initiatives and measurable business outcomes. This role connects the Fraud team and business partners to deliver capabilities that reduce fraud loss, increase customer trust, protect customers and digital assets, and balance security with customer experience. The Program Manager will govern scope, dependencies, risk, vendors, financials, operational readiness and benefits realization across use cases. Uses approved artificial intelligence and automation tools to improve program analysis, planning, reporting and decision support with appropriate human validation and data safeguards.

  

* Digital Fraud Strategy, Roadmap & Portfolio: Translate enterprise fraud strategy, threat intelligence, operational priorities, analytical insights and engineering dependencies into an integrated roadmap; manage initiative intake, prioritization, sequencing and portfolio governance across customer and workforce use cases
* Program Delivery & Operationalization: Lead complex digital fraud initiatives from business case, requirements and solution planning through engineering delivery, operational readiness, launch, adoption and benefits realization
* Governance, Risk & Controls: Coordinate fraud and identity-risk assessments, control requirements, privacy, accessibility, audit/regulatory evidence, customer-experience considerations and accountable approvals across business, identity and cybersecurity organizations
* Funding, Vendor & Contractor Management: Manage program funding, forecasts, business cases, vendor and platform governance, implementation partners, contracts, contractor delivery, risks and performance
* Matrix Delivery Leadership: Coordinate Product Owners, Business Analysts, Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Detection Engineering, Data Analytics and delivery partners through matrix leadership while preserving functional ownership and accountability
* Performance, Analytics & Continuous Improvement: Establish KPIs and KRIs for fraud loss, prevented loss, detection and decision performance, customer friction, operational outcomes, delivery health, platform performance and business value; use validated insights to drive continuous improvement
* Enterprise Partnership & Executive Communication: Partner with Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Fraud Intelligence and Detection Engineering, Fraud Data Analytics, EIAM, CIAM, Security Architecture, Digital Technology, Commercial, Legal/Compliance, Accessibility and
* Procurement; provide executive reporting, recommendations and decision support

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**

  

* Bachelor's degree required, with preference for Business, Program or Project Management, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, Analytics, Risk Management or a related field
* 3+ years of experience leading complex programs in digital fraud, cybersecurity, identity, risk, analytics, technology or operations, including cross-functional delivery, governance, financial management and executive stakeholder engagement
* Demonstrated program-management expertise in roadmap planning, scope and dependency management, requirements governance, risk and issue management, financial forecasting, vendor oversight, operational readiness, change management, KPI design and executive reporting
* Working knowledge of digital fraud, identity and authentication, fraud operations, detection engineering, analytics, customer journey risk and control governance
* Ability to use approved AI and automation tools responsibly to improve planning, analysis, documentation and reporting while validating outputs and protecting sensitive data
* Strong written and verbal communication, executive storytelling, facilitation, negotiation and decision-support skills; ability to translate between business, operational, analytical and technical teams and lead through influence in a matrixed environment
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United State

jobs.title: Enterprise Data Analytics Program Manager - Remote - Nationwide
jobs.description:
Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Enterprise Data Analytics Program Manager
  
  
Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare
  
  
At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.
  
  
Join the Vituity Team. At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.
  
  
**Vituity Locations:** Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Balance the needs of customers, business teams, and stakeholders with the capabilities and limitations of technical resources throughout the development process, ensuring that what is delivered meets the original goals and objectives of the request or product.
* Operate in areas of uncertainty and ambiguity and provide solid recommendations.
* Facilitate meaningful discussion to help develop sound business requirements and user stories, helping to interpret user needs and experience to design a workflow and/or product that efficiently meets the needs of the customer.
* Collaborate with technical teams and groom backlog to ensure that work efforts are aligned with product and business goals and objectives; assist in resolving roadblocks and managing escalations as required.
* Manage internal documentation (using Confluence) as well as issue/bug/enhancement ticket tracking (in Jira and ServiceNow); create and manage training and supporting content for users and customers (via SharePoint and other platforms).
* Evangelize products by working with key stakeholders to demonstrate value of tools; support user community and identify advocates to partner with.
* Become a subject matter expert in upstream data sources and flow to help identify gaps for various programs and practice lines.
* Participate in planning activities around system upgrades and migrations that would impact data sources or platforms that Practice Management (PM) and Physician Partner (PP) Operations users use directly or indirectly.
* Work with appropriate teams to help troubleshoot mitigate system failures and lapses in service and provide updates to users.
* Responsible for building and maintaining the relationship with the business stakeholders of the assigned platforms and stakeholders of the assigned MVPs.
* Responsible for developing and maintaining effective working relationships with other ITS teams.
* Effectively influences and collaborates with others, presenting and securing approval from senior management and other key stakeholders, as necessary.
* Manage process of data acquisition with RCM Data Acquisition, outside RCM groups, and other EMR vendors and hospital partners.
* Assess areas of opportunity where available data sources and/or systems can be leveraged in a report, dashboard, or tool that can add business value or operational insights.
* Use Tableau and other platforms to develop prototypes and engage with prospective users for feedback; assess value with stakeholders; if/when appropriate, determine next steps and produce documentation for production development.
* Research and stay informed of industry best practices for analytics and business intelligence.
* Provide or facilitate ad hoc analysis and reporting for business requests and needs with complexity or requirements beyond what is readily available within the PMD and other tools.
* Complete formal or informal training on current technology and Data/IT methodologies.
* Quarterly skip meeting with the manager of your manager.
* Identify a mentor and meet on a monthly basis.

Required Experience and Competencies
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution required.
* 3- 5 years of Product Management or equivalent experience required.
* Demonstrated background in using or implementing data analytic tools or dashboards required.
* Background in Hospital, Medical or Pharmaceuticals preferred.
* Knowledge of Cloud Technologies preferred.
* Basic knowledge of SQL or programming language preferred.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office software applications required.
* Working knowledge of the Agile Software Development Methodology preferred.
* Project Management or Program Management Professional (PMP or PgMP) preferred.

The Community
  
Even when you are working remotely, you are an important part of the Vituity Community. We offer plenty of opportunities to engage with other Vitans through a variety of virtual meet-and-greets, events and seminars.
  
  

* Monthly wellness events and programs such as yoga, HIIT classes, and more
* Trainings to help support and advance your professional growth
* Team building activities such as virtual scavenger hunts and holiday celebrations
* Flexible work hours
* Opportunities to attend Vituity community events including LGBTQ+ History, Día de los Muertos Celebration, Money Management/Money Relationship, and more

Benefits Beyond\*
  
Vituity cares about the whole you. With our comprehensive compensation and benefits package, we are mindful of what matters most, and support your needs of today and your plans for the future.
  
  

* Superior health plan options
* Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA, Life and ADD coverage, and more
* Top Tier 401(k) retirement savings plans that offers a $1.20 match for every dollar up to 6% plus discretionar

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and execution of a large-scale partner communications and content program. This role serves as the central point of coordination across the client, Odigo's strategy and content teams, writers, designers, and other contributors to ensure work stays organized, approvals move efficiently, deadlines are met, and deliverables are published on schedule.

The Project Manager will oversee an integrated editorial calendar spanning partner social content, executive thought leadership, blogs, launches, and supporting creative. The role requires someone who can manage a high volume of concurrent deliverables while maintaining visibility into priorities, dependencies, approvals, and performance.

The ideal candidate brings both strong project management capabilities and an understanding of GTM strategy and partner ecosystems, enabling them to connect day-to-day execution to broader partner, marketing, launch, and business priorities.

**Program & Project Management**

* Own the day-to-day project plan, production tracker, timelines, and delivery schedules across all program workstreams.
* Maintain a rolling editorial and production calendar covering social, executive, blog, launch, and supporting creative content.
* Coordinate assignments and dependencies across strategy, editorial, writing, design, social, and client teams.
* Lead weekly project status meetings and provide clear updates on deliverables, approvals, risks, upcoming milestones, and outstanding actions.
* Identify potential schedule or resource issues early and work with the team to resolve them before they impact delivery.
* Maintain organized project documentation, meeting notes, decisions, action items, and approval records.
* Support monthly planning sessions, performance reporting, and quarterly program reviews.

**Content Production & Workflow Management**

* Manage content from intake and assignment through drafting, creative development, review, approval, scheduling, and publication.
* Coordinate production of executive social posts, partner-page content, blogs, graphics, carousels, and supporting social content.
* Ensure writers and designers have the briefs, source materials, messaging, brand guidance, and deadlines required to complete their work.
* Manage review cycles and consolidate feedback so creative teams receive clear, actionable direction.
* Track executive and stakeholder approvals and proactively follow up when feedback is needed.
* Maintain a reserve pipeline of evergreen content to help protect publishing cadence when priorities or launch dates shift.

**Launch & Rapid-Turn Coordination**

* Manage accelerated content workflows tied to product announcements, launches, and industry events.
* Coordinate simultaneous production of blogs, executive posts, partner-page content, graphics, SEO metadata, reviews, and scheduling.
* Ensure launch materials move through the required review and approval process within compressed timelines.
* Monitor dependencies and immediately flag issues that could put a launch date at risk.

**Client & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day operational contact for client stakeholders.
* Coordinate meetings, interviews, approvals, content requests, and follow-ups.
* Maintain clear visibility into what Odigo needs from the client and when it is needed.
* Establish and reinforce agreed review and approval timelines.
* Coordinate with executive stakeholders and SMEs while respecting their limited availability.
* Escalate strategic, scope, resource, or relationship issues to the Engagement Lead as appropriate.

**Social Media & Publishing Coordination**

* Coordinate scheduling and publishing of approved content across designated social channels and platforms.
* Ensure content is scheduled against the approved editorial calendar.
* Monitor comments and engagement and route questions or issues to the appropriate client or Odigo team member.
* Confirm publishing status and troubleshoot scheduling or access issues.
* Maintain awareness of upcoming events, launches, partner priorities, and other opportunities that should be reflected in the content calendar.

**Reporting & Program Operations**

* Maintain accurate tracking of content volume, status, deadlines, approvals, and publication.
* Coordinate collection of channel and content performance metrics.
* Prepare or support monthly client-facing program reports.
* Track program trends, risks, bottlenecks, and delivery performance.
* Support quarterly reviews by consolidating results, learnings, upcoming priorities, and recommendations.
* Help continuously improve workflows as the program scales.

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of project or program management experience, preferably within marketing, communications, content, social media, or an agency environment.
* Familiarity with hyperscaler and technology partner ecosystems,
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams and high-volume deliverables.
* Strong understanding of content production workflows, including briefing, drafting, creative development, review, approval, and publishing.
* Experience working directly with clients and senior-level stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing deadlines and rapidly changing priorities without losing visibility into the broader program.
* Comfortable proactively following up with stakeholders and driving decisions and approvals.
* Familiarity with project management and collaboration platforms such as Monday.com, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or similar tools.
* Working knowledge of LinkedIn and social publishing workflows.
* Experience supporting reporting or performance measurement for content or social programs.

CirrusMD is redefining virtual care by delivering a Physician-first Care & Guidance solution that meets patients at their moment of need. Available 24/7/365, CirrusMD’s integrated care spans multiple specialties—from acute and chronic care to behavioral health. Our platform serves 10 million users across all 50 states and is offered exclusively through employers and health plans. Learn more at **cirrusmd.com****.**

-------------------

A great client experience starts long before go-live.

As a Client Onboarding Project Manager at CirrusMD, you’ll be at the center of bringing new clients to life, guiding them from signed contract through implementation, onboarding, and a successful launch.

You’ll connect the dots between clients, consultants, vendor partners, and teams across our organization, turning complex implementations into clear, actionable plans. Some days you’ll be mapping milestones and coordinating workstreams. Other days you’ll be solving an unexpected challenge, bringing the right experts together, or helping a client navigate an important decision.

Through it all, you’ll keep everyone moving toward the same goal: a smooth launch and a client experience that starts strong from day one.

If you love bringing order to complexity, building trusted relationships, solving problems, and watching a big project come together, we’d love to meet you.

* Keep things moving. Track deliverables, communicate progress, manage deadlines, and make sure important details don’t fall through the cracks.

* Jump into other high-impact work. Support priority projects through the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) as opportunities arise.
* Take on other responsibilities as needed to support our clients, team, and business.

----------------------------------

You’re the kind of person who can keep a complex project organized without losing sight of the people behind it.

You bring:

* A bachelor’s degree.
* Experience in project management and account or client management.
* Experience managing multiple complex projects with competing priorities, stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines.
* A collaborative approach and a knack for getting different teams moving toward the same goal.
* Strong organizational skills and the flexibility to adjust when priorities or plans change.
* Confidence leading meetings, asking thoughtful questions, and helping teams move toward decisions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including comfort working with clients, leaders, consultants, and subject matter experts.
* The ability to take something complicated and make it easier for others to understand.

This role is responsible for translating organizational strategy and priorities into actionable execution plans, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, with the right stakeholders engaged, and in alignment with broader business objectives. Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, this individual will serve as the operational backbone across Customer Engagement, Revenue, Marketing, Business Insights, Marketing Operations, and partner teams — bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to complex, cross-functional programs. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is energized by variety and ambiguity, and brings a creative, proactive approach to solving coordination and execution challenges.

* Build and maintain project plans, workback schedules, and milestone trackers that provide visibility into deliverables, dependencies, timelines, and risks across strategic initiatives

* Monitor progress across initiatives and proactively identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and competing priorities that could impact successful delivery
* Drive follow-through on actions, commitments, and key deliverables to support on-time execution
* Bring structure, clarity, and momentum to complex initiatives where priorities, stakeholders, and dependencies may evolve over time
* Act as a central coordination point across teams, ensuring the right stakeholders are engaged and aligned throughout program execution
* Coordinate activities across Customer Engagement, Revenue, Marketing, Marketing Operations, Business Insights, Customer Evidence, and other partner teams
* Facilitate working sessions, reviews, planning meetings, and execution touchpoints across workstreams
* Drive follow-up on actions, decisions, and commitments to help teams deliver against agreed plans
* Consolidate feedback, surface dependencies, and ensure accountability is clearly understood across initiatives
* Create clear and actionable communications that keep stakeholders informed, aligned, and focused on priorities
* Develop program updates, status reports, and leadership-ready summaries that provide visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and next steps
* Capture and communicate key decisions, actions, and commitments to support effective follow-through
* Maintain program documentation and shared resources that enable transparency and continuity across initiatives
* Support leadership reviews, planning sessions, and business update processes through preparation of materials and coordination of inputs
* Track actions, decisions, dependencies, and key milestones across concurrent initiatives
* Coordinate recurring program reviews and planning activities to ensure operational continuity
* Identify opportunities to improve planning, coordination, and execution processes across the portfolio

**Requirements:**

* 2+ years of experience in Program and Project Management, including building project plans, workback schedules, milestone trackers, and managing risk
* 2+ years of experience in cross-functional program coordination and stakeholder management within a matrixed organizational environment
* 2+ years of experience in executive communications, operational planning, and status reporting, including preparation of leadership-ready materials and documentation
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent programs or workstreams simultaneously while maintaining quality and delivery timelines

jobs.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?

If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.

At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.

If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

  

**ORGANIZATION SUMMARY**

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.

Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

World Relief seeks a Project Manager to become a part of the U.S. Advancement Department. This role serves as the central project and operations lead for the U.S. Advancement team, partnering with marketing, communications, fundraising, church engagement and offices across the U.S. to ensure strategic initiatives are planned, prioritized, and executed effectively. The position manages a portfolio of projects which support 14 U.S. offices and drives organizational alignment, process improvement, resource coordination, and project delivery. Success in this role will be demonstrated through the seamless execution of strategic initiatives across the U.S. Advancement portfolio, ensuring resources are aligned to organizational priorities and workloads are balanced effectively. Key outcomes include a reduction in project bottlenecks, successful delivery of integrated campaigns and initiatives, and stronger partnerships with the 14 U.S. offices, evidenced by enhanced collaboration, increased operational efficiency, and improved satisfaction with the support and services provided by the U.S. Advancement team.

### **ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Project Portfolio Management

* Manage and oversee all U.S. Advancement projects across marketing, communications, donor engagement, church engagement, fundraising campaigns, events, and strategic initiatives.

* Monitor project scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
* Facilitate prioritization of competing projects and resource allocation for the team.

Strategic Planning & Coordination

Operational Excellence

* Document workflows, processes, and standard operating procedures.

* Coordinate efforts across World Relief’s Advancement Division and U.S offices.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for project-related communication and issue resolution.
* Ensure stakeholders remain informed of project status, risks, and key decisions.
* Drive accountability for project deliverables.

* Mature and personal Christian faith
* Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
* Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
* Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document

**Project Manager — Defense Training & Content Production**

**DVI Training Systems (DVITS)**   
Location: Remote / Flexible Workplace (United States)  
Employment Type: Full-Time  
Work Schedule: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time

**Help Deliver Training That Matters.**

At DVI Training Systems (DVITS), we develop advanced, video-based technical training solutions that prepare military personnel for mission-critical operations. Our work spans defense aviation, weapons and mission systems, unmanned systems, maritime operations, and other complex technical environments.

We're looking for an experienced, highly organized Project Manager to help coordinate the people, processes, resources, and schedules behind our training development and production projects.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys managing complex work, building efficient systems, solving problems, and helping talented teams deliver exceptional results.

**About the Role**

As Project Manager, you'll coordinate training development projects from initial planning through final delivery, working closely with our Instructional Systems Design, Content Development, and Content Production teams.

You'll manage schedules, budgets, resources, Smartsheet workflows, and critical project logistics while maintaining clear communication with internal teams, outside subject matter experts, and customer stakeholders.

We're looking for someone who supports our teams in tracking and reporting progress, anticipating challenges and risks, taking initiative to manage change, and creating the structure needed to keep projects moving.

This position reports to our VP of Operations.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams, external subject matter experts, contractors, and project stakeholders.
* Manage project schedules and dependencies across technical content development, instructional design, video production, customer reviews, and delivery.
* Build, manage, and continuously improve project management workflows, dashboards, reports, and automations using Smartsheet.
* Track budgets, resource utilization, project expenses, and cost variances.
* Coordinate project logistics for production and content capture activities, including travel arrangements, facilities, scheduling, and external participants.
* Identify project risks, scheduling conflicts, resource constraints, and potential delays before they affect delivery.
* Prepare accurate project reports and maintain clear communication with leadership and customer stakeholders.
* Facilitate productive project meetings, planning sessions, and other Agile activities, such as retrospectives and after-action reviews.
* Continually improve project management systems and operational processes.
* Coordinate quality reviews, approvals, and final delivery requirements.

**What We're Looking For**

* At least five years of professional project management experience.
* Degree or certification in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong proficiency with Smartsheet, including project schedules, dashboards, reports, workflow development, and automation.
* Experience designing and maintaining effective project management systems.
* Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects, schedules, budgets, and resources.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience applying Agile project management principles.
* Ability to anticipate problems, recommend solutions, and work independently.
* Professionalism, accountability, and a collaborative approach to teamwork.

**Preferred Experience**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience in defense, aviation, government contracting, technical training, or multimedia production.
* Experience coordinating video production, content development, instructional design, or other specialized creative and technical workflows.
* Advanced Smartsheet administration, reporting, and workflow automation experience.

**Work Arrangement**

DVITS operates under a Flexible Workplace Policy. This position may be performed remotely from an approved U.S. work location; Atlanta residency is not required.

Employees must be available during regular working hours of 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time and maintain a secure, professional working environment that meets company requirements.

Participation in scheduled company meetings and periodic in-person gatherings is required. Occasional business travel may be necessary.

Our philosophy is straightforward:

Flexibility changes *where* we work. It does not change the standards by which we work.

**Why DVITS?**

At DVITS, the work we do has purpose. Our training solutions help prepare military personnel to operate complex systems and perform in demanding environments.

You'll work alongside experienced professionals from military aviation, instructional design, technical training, and media production. You'll also have the opportunity to help shape and improve the systems that support our continued growth.

Our culture is grounded in a simple commitment:

Mission First. Excellence Always.℠

We value initiative, accountability, collaboration, and people who take pride in the quality of their work.

**Export Control & Security Requirements**

Due to potential access to export-controlled information, applicants must qualify as U.S. Persons under applicable export control regulations, including 22 C.F.R. § 120.62.

Employment is contingent upon completion of applicable background and security screenings. Additional government security requirements may apply to assigned projects.

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume and a cover letter describing your relevant project management and Smartsheet experience to:

careers@dvitrainingsystems.com

Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. jobs.description:
**About Revolut**

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

**About the role**

Our Information Security team protects Revolut's systems, data, and people. They combine technical expertise with a proactive, risk-based mindset to stay ahead of threats and keep our technology and customers secure at every step.

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT**

As the Sales Operations Analyst, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the commercial operations of USGBC and GBCI. In this role, you'll transform commercial data and business needs into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and effective Salesforce workflows that support sales efficiency and effectiveness.

You'll support Market Leads, Account Management teams, and leadership with pipeline, forecasting, account coverage, customer retention, expansion, and partner performance reporting. You'll also perform business analysis to define Salesforce requirements, test workflows, and support the adoption of approved commercial processes.

You will support global sales operations across all regions by helping establish consistent reporting practices, improving data quality, and providing accurate commercial insights that enable informed decision-making across markets.

You'll report to the director of sales operations and work closely with regional directors, market leads, account management, client solutions, sales enablement, technology, and finance to support sales success across all global regions and markets.

As an individual contributor within the global sales operations team, you will help standardize commercial data, reporting, and business processes while supporting regional teams with their operational and analytical needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global commercial reporting and analytics:** build and maintain approved reports and dashboards covering sales pipeline, conversion rates, opportunity stage aging, win/loss trends, account coverage, customer retention, expansion, and channel partner contributions. Coordinate with marketing and communications on campaign performance, lead routing, and return-on-investment reporting. Analyze material trends, identify data limitations, and recommend follow-up actions. Support consistent global reporting standards while providing regional and consolidated performance insights to commercial leadership.
* **Sales forecasting and commercial planning:** prepare forecasting inputs, assumptions, scenarios, and variance analyses to support commercial planning and decision-making. Identify incomplete information, inconsistent opportunity values, and reporting discrepancies. Support territory planning, account coverage, quota and KPI distribution, and workload analysis while maintaining traceability and preserving opportunity owners' accountability for their forecasts. Help consolidate and analyze forecast data across global regions to improve reporting consistency, visibility, and accuracy.
* **Data quality, governance, and commercial attribution:** monitor and improve data accuracy across salesforce accounts, contacts, opportunities, account hierarchies, required fields, customer and partner relationships, and commercial records. Identify duplicate or incomplete records, coordinate corrections with record owners, and reconcile approved commercial measures with finance to prevent duplicate attribution. Support the implementation and consistent application of global data quality standards, reporting definitions, and commercial attribution practices.
* **Salesforce business analysis and requirements documentation:** gather and document business requirements, current and proposed workflows, user needs, field definitions, reporting logic, process handoffs, and acceptance criteria. Maintain a prioritized salesforce business-improvement backlog in partnership with the director of sales operations and technology. Collaborate with global stakeholders to identify regional business requirements and support scalable system improvements that align with approved global commercial processes.
* **System testing and change implementation:** prepare and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), coordinate business testers, document defects, track testing results, and validate whether approved business requirements have been met. Support change readiness and coordinate with authorized technology teams for technical remediation and production deployment. Support cross-regional user testing and implementation readiness to ensure system changes are effective for global commercial teams.
* **Salesforce adoption and user support:** develop process documentation, job aids, and user guidance to support the effective use of salesforce and approved commercial workflows. Provide targeted system demonstrations, troubleshoot business-process questions, and collaborate with sales enablement on training and reinforcement. Escalate access, security, integration, and technical issues to the appropriate technology teams. Support consistent CRM adoption and user understanding across regions, including teams operating in different time zones.
* **Commercial process improvement and standardization:** maintain reporting schedules, metric definitions, process documentation, and audit trails. Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual work, and strengthen commercial processes through practical automation and process improvements. Protect confidential customer and partner information and operate within approved system permissions. Help develop and maintain standardized global reporting procedures, workflows, and documentation that support consistent commercial operations.
* **Cross-functional collaboration and regional support:** partner with regional directors, market leads, account managers, finance, technology, marketing, product, client solutions, and sales enablement to resolve reporting issues, clarify commercial workflows, and support operational improvements. Act as a central analytical and business-process resource for global commercial teams, supporting consistent data interpretation, knowledge sharing, and coordination across regions.
* **Analytical ownership and quality assurance:** independently manage assigned reports, dashboards, data quality checks, business requirements, and testing

---------------------

FEHE Enterprises, Inc. is seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to transform healthcare, financial, and operational information into reliable reports, interactive dashboards, and actionable recommendations. This position will work with leadership and cross-functional teams to monitor performance, identify trends, improve data quality, and support informed business decisions. The role is based in Atlanta, Georgia, with remote work eligibility.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Collect and combine data from claims, enrollment, provider, financial, customer service, and operational systems; maintain organized reporting datasets.
* Clean, validate, reconcile, and investigate incomplete, duplicate, inconsistent, or unusual records; document data-quality checks and findings.
* Analyze claims volume and costs, healthcare utilization, provider performance, service trends, expenses, and operational results to identify drivers and variances.
* Create and maintain Excel and Power BI or Tableau dashboards that track key performance indicators (KPIs), performance against targets, and emerging risks.

* Support forecasting, budgeting, cost-control initiatives, and process improvements using historical trends and clear analytical models.
* Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Quality Assurance, IT, and other stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements and present findings to nontechnical audiences.
* Protect confidential healthcare and business information, maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails, and follow applicable privacy requirements.

---------------------------------------

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data cleaning, formulas, pivot tables, reconciliation, and analytical reporting.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying and extracting data; experience creating dashboards in Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience working with multiple datasets, identifying data-quality issues, and translating complex information into meaningful business insights.
* Strong analytical reasoning, accuracy, organizational skills, and the ability to manage deadlines and competing reporting requests.
* Ability to communicate findings clearly in written reports, dashboards, and discussions with leadership.
* Healthcare claims, provider network, utilization, financial, or healthcare operations analytics experience is strongly valued.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Timely and accurate reporting; dependable dashboards; improved data completeness and consistency; clear explanations of trends and exceptions; and actionable recommendations that help leadership monitor costs, quality, and operational performance.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Dashly is a fraud intelligence startup that uses data across employers, insurers, and contractors to fight fraud in injury claims. We expose fraud networks that cost Americans billions of dollars annually, slow commercial development, and erode trust in blue-collar industries.

Backed by Mosaic GP, Altai Ventures, and Remarkable Ventures, with a $5.8M seed round.

**About the Role**
------------------

Fraud is rarely one person acting alone. Organized claim fraud is often run by networks: groups of associated people acting together through a pattern of related claims over time. The cost falls on carriers, contractors, and the industries that depend on fair claims. The evidence is public but fragmented across dockets, deposition transcripts, claim files, and social media.

Dashly investigates organized fraud enterprises: formal or informal groups of individuals, and the counsel, providers, and associates around them, linked by shared addresses, phone numbers, employers, and narratives. We build cases around the structure of organized fraud: the enterprise, each member's association with it, a pattern of related conduct, how long that conduct continues, and its reach across state lines. Our work gives clients and their counsel evidence for fraud litigation.

As a Fraud Intelligence Analyst, you will design, run, and QA the automated OSINT workflows behind our investigations. You will build and orchestrate agentic AI workflows (LLM agents) for account discovery and attribution, court-filing and deposition extraction, media review, and report drafting. You will integrate third-party OSINT, licensed, and public-records data sources via API, and you will own detection quality (precision, recall, and false-positive rate) across the pipeline.

This role suits a recent graduate in cybercrime, cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, computer science, or a related field who combines a builder's mindset with an investigator's rigor. Prior military or government experience is welcome.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design and operationalize automated OSINT workflows that take a claim from initial identifiers to a finished report: account discovery, attribution, collection, court-document extraction, and link analysis.
* Build, prompt, and supervise AI agents and LLM-based automation for investigative tasks, with human-in-the-loop verification before any output reaches a client.
* Integrate OSINT, licensed, and public-records data sources through their APIs, and evaluate each new data source on historical cases before production use.
* Measure and improve detection quality: track precision, recall, and false-positive and false-negative rates against analyst-confirmed accounts, and tune workflows accordingly.
* Identify, attribute, and verify claimants' online accounts and records using strong identifiers (address, phone, email, date of birth).
* Review public photos and posts and flag activity that contradicts claimant testimony or statements to the insurer.
* Extract facts from court filings, deposition transcripts, and claim files, and use link analysis to map relationships among claimants, counsel, addresses, phone numbers, and associates, documenting enterprise structure, member associations, and patterns of related conduct across claims.
* Produce clear, evidence-backed investigative reports that clients and their counsel can use in fraud litigation.
* Partner with senior investigators and engineers to refine investigative methods, tooling, and report quality.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Required:** Experience using AI coding agents, terminal coding agents, or CLI-based AI development tools for research, writing, or code, with the judgment to validate their output (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or open source tools).
* Bachelor's or master's degree (or in progress) in cybercrime, cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, computer science, or a related field.
* 0-2 years of experience in OSINT, investigations, threat intelligence, or a related discipline, including coursework, internships, CTF competitions, or military or government service.
* Working knowledge of OSINT collection and analysis techniques and rigorous source documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience integrating REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON), SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
* Familiarity with graph and network analysis for detecting linked actor structures.
* Understanding of detection-performance concepts (precision, recall, false positives).
* Familiarity with court records and legal documents, including dockets, deposition transcripts, and fraud complaints.
* Proficiency in Python or a similar scripting language for data analysis and task automation.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Compensation:** The base salary range is $70,000 – $100,000, with flexibility depending on a candidate's background and experience. A company equity plan is also included in our compensation package.
* **Well-being:** 100% medical coverage with dental and vision.
* **Sponsorship:** We welcome candidates on OPT (Optional Practical Training). We do not offer other visa sponsorship.
* **Location:** This role is based on-site 5 days per week in our Chelsea, NY office.

**Job Description**
-------------------

About the Agency:  
  
  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.  
  
  
  
Your Team:  
  
  
  
The Office of Development (OOD) leads the agency’s effort to create and preserve affordable housing in collaboration with other HPD offices as well as other city, state and federal agencies. The OOD is comprised of eight divisions that administer a range of programs. These divisions include Portfolio Management & Conversions, New Construction Finance, Special Needs Housing, Building and Land Development Services (BLDS), Homeownership Opportunities and Preservation, Preservation Finance, Compliance and Enforcement, and Housing Incentives.  
  
  
  
The Division of Portfolio Management & Conversions manages development projects after closing with an initial loan to ensure adherence to program and accounting requirements, conversion of construction loans to permanent financing, deployment of rental assistance to tenants prior to project stabilization, and timely completion of these HPD-assisted projects. The division administers multiple programs including Conversions & Rental Assistance, Requisitions, and Construction Monitoring & Completions. These programs facilitate the financial and physical viability, as well as affordability of privately-owned residential buildings throughout New York City. The Division plays a key role in implementation and successful completion housing projects originating from loan programs throughout HPD’s Office of Development.  
  
  
  
Your Impact:  
  
  
  
The Construction & Completions unit is responsible for monitoring the construction of HPD funded affordable housing projects to track and report on construction progress, and to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve significant construction and completion issues that could adversely impact the project, project stakeholders and residents, and/or HPD’s ability to achieve its mission or meet its targets. The unit also assists the Requisions unit to resolve delays and processing issues that could delay the processing of construction requisitions and change orders in a timely manner. In addition, it assists the Conversions program in supporting the timely resolution of issues that might hinder projects’ ability to convert to permanent financing under budget. The WSJ Opinion section has long served as a forum for intelligent, values-driven commentary, dedicated to advocating a consistent philosophy that can be summed up as ‘free markets, free people.’ While we aim to persuade, every word we publish is the product of rigorous reporting, research and debate. WSJ Opinion offers sharp, original analysis and strong points of view on the news of the day. This position supports the Opinion section’s audience data and insights work.

The Wall Street Journal’s Opinion section is seeking an **Audience Data Analyst** based in New York to support our audience reporting and editorial performance tracking.

Reporting directly to the Manager of Audience Data Analysis and Insights, you will be responsible for tracking audience trends, updating reporting dashboards, and translating audience behavior into clear takeaways for editorial leadership. **About Gusto**

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

**About the Role:**

Gusto's Customer Experience team is changing how we serve small businesses: new service models, a telephony platform migration, and the data infrastructure to support both. We are hiring a Business Intelligence Analyst to own the data layer that makes this work.

You will work directly with CX leaders to identify and scope priorities, own the foundation of pipelines, data models, and dashboards that make CX data trustworthy, and use that foundation to answer causal questions about what actually moves customer outcomes. The strongest candidates pair real coding and statistical depth with the judgment to know which question is worth answering.

**About the Team:**

CX Data and Insights is the analytical backbone of Gusto's Customer Experience organization. We define the metrics CX leaders run the business on, and we produce the analysis that shapes operational roadmap decisions.

**Here's what you'll do day-to-day:**

* **Lead:** Own ambiguous problems, design analysis and measurement frameworks, and introduce policies and practices by which data integrity is monitored and enforced within your domain.
* **Execution:** Deliver multiple high-impact projects, balancing trade-offs to maximize business value, and maintain clear expectations of deliverables and timelines.
* **Strategic Partnership:** Partner with CX leaders, cross-function data-science teams, tool developers (i.e. Salesforce), and data engineering to align on strategy.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Apply advanced statistical methods and AI-driven anomaly detection to proactively uncover opportunities, diagnose performance issues, and shape CX strategy, separating signal from noise. Navigate messy, conflicting data sources to establish reliable sources of truth. Use AI to accelerate hypothesis generation, code drafting, cross-source reconciliation, validation, and build agents to automate repetitive tasks.
* **Develop and scale reporting:** Define DBT and Snowflake data pipeline requirements for evolving CX data sources, build and maintain monitoring systems, and streamline dashboards for day-to-day operation and self-serve insights.
* **Independence:** Independently determines analytical research, metrics and/or data products to achieve annual objectives, and proactively resolving conflicts or misalignment across stakeholders.
* **Scale the Craft:** Up-level the team's best practices in data modeling and schema design, expand our toolsets (e.g., Databricks for AI-augmented modeling and anomaly detection) where they accelerate CX outcomes, drive improvements in data quality, rigor, and adoption of better data capabilities, and mentor other data practitioners.
* **Communication:** Present complex findings in a structured, compelling way to technical and non-technical stakeholders, fostering a data-informed mindset across the company.

**Here's what we're looking for:**

* 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or Data Governance.
* Strong SQL and Python proficiency, capable of querying and analyzing large datasets with ease.
* Strong foundation in data modeling, schema design, and data quality best practices, with functional experience working on cloud platforms like Snowflake.
* Proven experience building and maintaining robust data reporting pipelines and ETL workflows.
* Demonstrated experience designing or operating governance for AI-assisted analytics outputs. At minimum: validation standards for AI-generated code and metric definitions, drift and source-of-truth audits on dashboards that feed operational decisions, and documented rules for when human review is non-negotiable on performance-adjacent data products. Comfort working inside an organization's AI use policy.
* Clear, direct communication style. You can explain a complex data investigation to a non-technical stakeholder in 1-2 sentences before diving into the details.
* Comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities, and driving projects forward without waiting for perfect requirements.
* Frequent, practical use of AI in analytics workflows with concrete examples (not aspirational interest). You can describe specific ways AI has changed how you scaffold pipelines, write and review code, validate data, or generate documentation, and you know where human verification is non-negotiable.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is $132,210/yr to $165,263/yr in Denver, $160,000/yr to $200,000/yr for New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. The role requires strong planning, execution, monitoring, and control, with clear accountability for measurable outcomes, timely decisions, and delivery within approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk tolerances.

The successful candidate will convert business needs into executable plans, coordinate IT, business, and vendor teams, manage competing priorities, and provide accurate, decision-oriented reports and dashboards for leadership.

· **Outcome-Based Delivery:** Define measurable outcomes, benefits, KPIs, acceptance criteria and target dates; track results through post-implementation review.

· **Integrated Planning:** Develop and maintain scope, work breakdown structure, schedule, milestones, dependencies, critical path, resources, budget, procurement, quality, risk, communications, testing, training, deployment and transition plans.

· **Monitoring and Control:** Measure performance against baselines using milestone, schedule, budget, resource, quality, risk and forecast indicators; initiate corrective action when required.

· **Reporting and Dashboards:** Produce concise weekly and monthly status reports, portfolio dashboards and executive presentations using Microsoft Project, Excel, Power BI, SharePoint and approved PPM tools.

· **Forecasting and Recovery:** Identify trends early, maintain realistic completion forecasts, and develop recovery plans with options, impacts and recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Lead IT projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, implementation, transition and closure across platforms such as IBM Maximo, Esri GIS, Genesys, SAP, Oracle, SharePoint and AI-enabled technologies.

· Define and control scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, constraints, success measures and acceptance criteria with business and IT stakeholders.

· Build and maintain logic-linked schedules with realistic durations, resource assignments, dependencies, critical path, milestones, baseline dates and delivery forecasts.

· Manage budgets, forecasts, resource plans, capacity needs, procurement activities and vendor commitments; reconcile actuals and forecasts with approved funding.

We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

**Shape the Future of National Security—Join MITRE and Tackle the Toughest Challenges with Innovation and Impact!**

Are you an experienced professional passionate about solving complex challenges to safeguard our nation? At MITRE, you’ll collaborate with top minds in engineering, science, and technology, leveraging cutting-edge research and experimentation to address the nation’s most pressing challenges.

jobs.title: Capital Project Manager
jobs.description:
Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust is one of the leading providers of elective care services within North-West London. We are looking for a talented, highly motivated and experienced Project Manager to advise and support the Project Director, DDO/GM, Project Sponsors, Project Board/team and senior clinicians and to take predominant responsibility for the coordination, management, and delivery of Trust Capital projects to ensure objectives are achieved in terms of specific performance, time, cost and quality.
  
  
The post holder is required to provide and receive complex specialist technical information to and from a wide range of parties at various levels within and out with the organisation, including staff, contractors, suppliers and design teams where agreement, co-operation or negotiation is required.
  
  
The post holder will manage all documentation from initial brief to handover ensuring compliance with relevant statutory and non-statutory standards, health & safety guidance, regulations, codes of practice, NHS guidance documents, British Standards, building regulations, planning authority guidance and the Treasury’s Green Book business case guidance.
  
  
Responsible for the project management of Business Case deliverables which include; new works, refurbishment, building adaptation and conversion schemes ensuring that projects meet user’s requirements, standards, within budget and to acceptable quality standards in compliance with the Trusts financial instructions and policies.
  
  
Be the lead specialist for allocated projects and will have significant discretion in relation to daily duties. Work is reviewed at least annually through a structured Personal Development Plan and Performance Appraisal system.
  
  
**Please note:** Some roles may require weekend shifts at multiple sites.
  
  
Our Trust is one of England's top-performing and safest trusts. We operate two main acute hospital sites—Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital—along with award-winning clinics across North West London.
  
  
Our nearly 7,500 staff care for a diverse population of 1.5m, providing full clinical services including maternity, A&E and children’s services, plus specialist HIV and sexual health care. The CQC rates us Good in safety, effectiveness, care and responsiveness, and Outstanding in leadership and resource use.
  
  
We continually invest in our facilities, including a £30m expansion of critical care at Chelsea and an £80m Ambulatory Diagnostic Centre at West Mid.
  
  
We are delivering sustainable healthcare through our Green Plan. In line with Greener NHS ambitions, we aim for net zero carbon emissions by 2045. Achieving this requires collective effort. We encourage staff to reduce their impact on carbon, waste and pollution wherever possible. Every action counts to create a healthier, more sustainable future.
  
  
We are committed to equal opportunities and believe diversity drives innovation and excellence. We welcome applications from the global majority, veterans and underrepresented communities, valuing the perspectives they bring.
  
  
The postholder will lead and manage capital projects from inception through design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the required clinical, operational and quality standards. They will provide senior management with accurate and timely information on project progress, finances, risks and key decisions.
  
  
They will work closely with clinical, operational, infection control, estates and finance teams to develop project briefs and business cases, ensuring requirements, risks, costs and operational impacts are fully considered. They will manage project budgets, cash flow, expenditure and forecasts, maintaining appropriate financial controls and compliance with Trust procedures.
  
  
The postholder will procure and manage consultants, contractors and design teams, overseeing design development and ensuring schemes meet agreed technical, statutory, clinical and financial requirements. They will maintain effective project governance, risk management, reporting, communication and document control throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
During construction, they will monitor programme, quality, health and safety, costs and contractor performance, including undertaking site inspections and attending progress meetings. They will manage the interface between construction activities and operational healthcare services, helping to minimise disruption to patients, staff and clinical services.
  
  
They will lead and coordinate commissioning, snagging, practical completion and handover, ensuring developments are safe and operationally ready before occupation. This will include ensuring defects are addressed and appropriate technical, health and safety and maintenance information is provided.
  
  
The postholder will maintain and monitor the capital programme, including project milestones, financial forecasts, funding requirements and key risks. They will contribute to the development of the Estate Strategy, capital procedures, policies and quality management arrangements and support continuous improvement across Capital Projects and Estates.
  
  
The role will ensure compliance with Trust Standing Financial Instructions, procurement requirements, health and safety legislation, NHS requirements and relevant statutory and regulatory standards, while maintaining high standards of professional conduct, financial probity and accountability.

jobs.title: SOC Tier 1 Security Analyst
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
We are looking for motivated and technically skilled **SOC Tier 1 Security Analysts** to join our internal Security Operations Centre (SOC) within a global enterprise organisation.  
  
This is an opportunity to be part of a growing in-house cybersecurity operation, responsible for monitoring, detecting, investigating and responding to security threats across a complex international IT environment.  
  
The successful candidates will work with modern security technologies and collaborate closely with cybersecurity and IT teams.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  

* Monitor and triage security alerts, events and incidents across enterprise environments.
* Perform initial investigations using SIEM, EDR/XDR and Microsoft security technologies.
* Identify potential threats, suspicious activities, indicators of compromise (IOCs) and abnormal behaviour.
* Execute established incident response playbooks and escalation procedures.
* Investigate phishing attempts, suspicious logins, malware alerts and endpoint threats.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, investigation timelines and handover records.
* Support threat hunting, detection improvement and security automation initiatives.
* Work closely with internal cybersecurity, infrastructure and IT teams.
* Participate in 24/7 rotational shifts, including nights and weekends.

  
**Required Qualifications**  
  

* 1–3 years of experience in a SOC, cybersecurity operations or security monitoring role.
* Understanding of cybersecurity threats, attack techniques and incident response processes.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM and endpoint security solutions.
* Good knowledge of Windows, networking, DNS, authentication protocols and Microsoft 365 environments.
* Ability to investigate security incidents and distinguish genuine threats from false positives.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and communication abilities.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 shift environment.

  
**Advantageous Skills**  
  

* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR and Entra ID.
* Familiarity with KQL, MITRE ATT&CK and threat intelligence.
* Experience with SOAR or security automation.
* Relevant certifications such as Security+, SC-200, CySA+ or equivalent.
* Basic scripting skills using PowerShell or Python.

  
**What We Offer**  
  

* An opportunity to contribute to the development of an in-house SOC within a global enterprise.
* Exposure to diverse cybersecurity technologies and international business environments.
* Professional training and career development opportunities.
* A collaborative cybersecurity team with opportunities to grow professionally.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.

In this role, you will analyse security events, investigate potential threats, validate and manage high-priority incidents, and execute decisive containment actions to minimise overall impact while escalating unresolved incidents to security engineering teams.

This person will monitor and remediate security incidents across on-prem, identity, and cloud-based environments for internal corporate infrastructure and enterprise client engagements. This is a remote role from either the UK, Ireland, or Poland.

  

### **Responsibilities:**

* Lead triage, scoping, containment, and eradication for medium-to-high severity security incidents across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud environments.
* Perform deep-dive investigations, threat isolation, and query hunting leveraging CrowdStrike Falcon (Host Timeline, Real Time Response).
* Investigate identity compromises, phishing campaigns, and suspicious account activities using Google Admin Console (Investigation Tool, Email Log Search, Token Auditing).
* Analyse ingress edge telemetry, CDN traffic patterns, WAF events, and web server logs (including Cloudflare and Acquia application environments) to detect, trace, and mitigate web attacks, DDoS conditions, and botnet/scraping abuse.
* Maintain and continuously update incident response plans and runbooks for efficient incident response, collaborating with engineering to automate containment workflows.
* Coordinate cross-departmental remediation tasks and escalate unresolved incidents with clear technical root-cause analysis (RCA) aligned with MITRE ATT&CK.
* Collaborate with content production for security awareness and mentorship.

**About You**
-------------

### **The essentials:**

* 5+ years of direct experience in Security Operations (SOC), Incident Response, or similar hands-on technical operational roles.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering/Information Security, or equivalent practical experience.
* Deep operational experience utilising CrowdStrike (investigation workflows, Host Timeline, Real Time Response, and query hunting).
* Proven experience leveraging Google Admin Console (Investigation Tool, Email Log Search, Token Auditing) for phishing, BEC, and identity investigations.
* Hands-on experience with industry-leading security tools across EDR, SWG, SIEM, and MDM platforms.
* Solid understanding of network protocols, traffic flow, and the OSI model.
* Experience with log analysis, malware triage, and digital forensics.
* Proven track record of operating autonomously during incidents with minimal supervision.
* Practical experience leveraging AI tools, LLMs, or agentic workflows to assist analysis, scripting, or automation.
* Working ITIL knowledge and functional familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Courteous, articulate, and educated in interpersonal delivery. Maintains a polite, respectful, and calm demeanor with internal teammates, leadership, and external clients even during incident bridges.
* Ability to confidently and politely present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-directed, resourceful, and critical thinker with proactive problem-solving instincts.
* Strong personal anxiety management and self-organisation during high-pressure incidents.
* Eager to learn, experiment with emerging tooling, and actively suggest process enhancements.

### **Not a must, but a plus:**

* Demonstrated hands-on and reflexive triage/containment instincts over theoretical knowledge or paper certifications (certifications like CISSP, Sec+, or CEH are welcome, but secondary to proven live-fire execution).
* Experience analysing Cloudflare edge/WAF logs and Acquia/Drupal web server access logs for application-layer anomalies, scraping, and volumetric spikes.
* Hands-on experience with modern SIEM / SecOps platforms:
* Cloud security experience (GCP, AWS, Azure) in production environments.

* Exposure to Blue/Red/Purple team simulation exercises.

**Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!**
---------------------------------------------

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

------------------

* Strong understanding of permissible use, privacy, and data-handling requirements.
