jobs.title: Program Manager (Special Projects)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the full technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system (ArsenalOS) that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As Program Manager for Special Projects/Triage, you will own the intake-to-execution lifecycle for manufacturing technology requests routed to MDP from ManTech stakeholders. You will scope work, define deliverables, coordinate execution across MDP teams, and ensure every project has explicit scope, timeline, exit criteria, and clear handoff—no open-ended engagements.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own the intake and triage process for manufacturing technology requests from ManTech teams, evaluating requests for fit, feasibility, and alignment with MDP capabilities and priorities.
* Define and maintain clear intake criteria that separate ManTech special projects from standing line-of-effort work, ensuring requests are appropriately scoped and routed.
* Partner with ManTech stakeholders to understand their needs, translate ambiguous requests into well-defined project scopes with explicit deliverables, timelines, and success criteria.
* Scope and structure special projects with clear boundaries—defining what is in scope, what is out of scope, required resources, dependencies, and exit criteria before work begins.
* Coordinate project execution across MDP engineering teams, ensuring special projects are staffed, prioritized appropriately, and delivered on time without disrupting standing initiatives.
* Drive projects from kickoff through delivery and handoff, maintaining transparency with stakeholders on status, risks, blockers, and timeline changes.
* Establish and enforce governance processes that prevent scope creep, ensure accountability, and maintain discipline around project closure and handoff.
* Build and maintain a portfolio view of all active special projects, tracking status, resource allocation, and capacity to take on new requests.
* Facilitate kickoff meetings, status reviews, and retrospectives for special projects, ensuring clear communication and alignment across MDP and ManTech teams.
* Identify patterns in incoming requests that indicate opportunities for platform capabilities, standardized solutions, or process improvements that reduce future special project volume.
* Work with MDP leadership to balance special project demand against standing initiative roadmaps, escalating conflicts and recommending prioritization decisions.
* Document and communicate handoff criteria, transition plans, and ongoing support expectations for completed special projects.
* Build strong working relationships with ManTech stakeholders, establishing trust and credibility as a reliable partner who delivers on commitments.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, or technical program management roles, ideally in fast-paced technology or manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated ability to scope ambiguous requests into well-defined projects with clear deliverables, timelines, and success criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with proven experience managing expectations, negotiating scope, and saying "no" diplomatically when necessary.

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager - GBSG Commercial Operations, US GTM
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit is a mission-driven, global financial platform company that gives everyone the opportunity to prosper. We do this by using technology to solve our customers’ most important problems. We serve customers by finding more ways to put more money in their pockets, eliminating work and drudgery so they can focus on their lives and what matters to them, and ensuring that every financial decision that they make, they make it with confidence. We are also at an important point in Intuit’s transformation, as AI and human intelligence reshape both the experiences we deliver for customers and how we operate. Across GBSG, that means making sharper choices about where we invest, how we grow, and how we move with greater speed and focus.

As a Principal Program Manager, you will sit at the center of Commercial Operations, the connective tissue driving execution across the commercial organization. You'll own the program management rhythm, drive the cross-functional programs that unlock growth and profitability, and turn ambiguous business problems into structured plans and decisions leadership can act on. Working at the intersection of program execution, data analysis, and AI-enabled operations, you'll partner closely with finance, marketing, sales, and product to translate priorities into roadmaps, milestones, and measurable outcomes, and to build the operating cadence that keeps them on track. Be part of a high-growth environment where your contributions have direct, visible impact. We are looking for a hands-on program leader who is an avid learner, experimenter, and builder, ready to rewire how Commercial Operations runs in the AI era.

**Responsibilities**

* **Program Management and Cross-functional Collaboration:** Lead strategic programs from conception through execution, collaborating with finance, marketing, sales, and product teams to ensure alignment and effective implementation. Build operational rigor through stakeholder identification and management, program roadmaps, detailed end-to-end plans, and clear ownership; identify risks and dependencies early, drive mitigation strategies, and keep leaders informed on status, tradeoffs, and the path to green.
* **Planning Rhythm and Operating Cadence:** Own and run the operating cadence that keeps the quarterly and annual plan on track, including program reviews, milestone tracking, and decision forums. Help leaders make explicit choices about priorities, sequencing, and resourcing, and use AI-assisted tools to compress cycle time and get to decisions faster.
* **Performance and Data Analysis:** Identify and recommend improvements to processes and systems, and use AI and automation to expand the scope and speed of analysis and to automate recurring reporting so effort shifts from data assembly to insight.
* **Executive Communication:** Shape executive decisions by distilling program status, data, and tradeoffs into clear recommendations and alternatives. Communicate through crisp presentations, written narratives, structured program roadmaps, and dashboards that create the clarity and alignment leaders need to make decisions and move.
* **Operating in Ambiguity:** Act as a proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment without a fixed playbook. Frame the critical issues and dependencies that need action, determine the optimal path forward before issues become blockers, and operationalize creative solutions with resourcefulness.
* **AI Enablement and Velocity:** Bring a demonstrated track record of using AI to meaningfully increase personal and team throughput. Design changes that address root causes rather than adding another process or layer.

**Qualifications**

This role demands a blend of program management expertise, analytical rigor, and leadership skills to drive effective execution and operational efficiencies in a complex and evolving environment.

  

* 7+ years of experience in program management, business operations, or strategy consulting, ideally with experience at large technology companies or management consulting.
* Experience leading large, complex, cross-functional programs end to end, including roadmap development, milestone and dependency management, risk mitigation, and translating strategy into operating plans.
* Track record of working cross‑functionally with product, data scientists, finance, and marketing channel owners. Familiarity with marketing measurement and performance metrics
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills. Ability to develop clear and impactful reports, roadmaps, and presentations for stakeholders. Demonstrated leadership abilities with experience influencing and building partnerships across all levels of an organization, up to senior executive audiences.
* Proven ability to manage multiple complex programs simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills and a bias for action. Comfortable working in a dynamic, high-growth environment with ambiguity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data analysis and KPI trend analysis a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degree such as an MBA or a program management certification (e.g., PMP) a plus.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. jobs.title: Corporate Security Investigations & Protective Intelligence Manager
jobs.description:
**Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!**
---------------------------------------------

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

**Role**
--------

The Corporate Security Investigations & Protective Intelligence Manager will identify and investigate threats to our people, offices, and community.

* In this role, you will:

  + Build and run the Corporate Security investigations case management system, preferably using internal AI tools to ship quickly, and select and manage external investigative tools.
  + Conduct investigations in close partnership with Trust & Risk, People and Legal teams.
  + Serve as a member of the threat management team to determine when on-platform behavior, reports, or escalations signal a credible risk of in-person harm, and assist in threat assessment, mitigation, and response.
* You’ll sit within Whatnot’s Corporate Security team and work closely with Trust & Risk, Legal, People, CyberSecurity, and IT. You’ll be hands-on in the cases and the tools while also operating as the program owner.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Protective Intelligence & Law Enforcement Outreach Management**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor open-source and platform signals for emerging threats, and deliver concise intelligence products to Corporate Security and business partners.
* In partnership with Trust & Risk and other members of the Threat Management team, determine when on-platform issues (harassing or threatening messages, escalating disputes, concerning behavior toward hosts, sellers, or buyers) could translate into in-person incidents, and collaborate on threat assessment and recommended response.
* Partner with Trust & Risk on escalation criteria and handoffs between platform enforcement and Corporate Security.
* Provide protective intelligence and threat assessments to support company events, executive protection, and high-profile business activities.
* Partner with Trust & Risk and Legal to map the landscape of law enforcement partners and playbooks for proactive law enforcement partnership.

**Internal Investigations & Threat Management**
-----------------------------------------------

* In partnership with the People and Legal teams, conduct internal security investigations.
* Support compliance with workplace violence prevention requirements, including SB 553 in California, in partnership with the Legal and People teams.
* Maintain rigorous evidence handling, documentation, and confidentiality standards.
* Establish processes for sharing investigative findings, threat assessments, and recommended security actions with appropriate internal stakeholders while maintaining confidentiality.

**Case Management System (Build) & Investigative Tooling Management**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Design, build, and manage Whatnot’s investigations and case management system, a purpose-built alternative to platforms like Ontic, using internal AI tools to develop.

* Source, evaluate, and manage investigative and intelligence tools, such as Clear, TLO, or other public-records and OSINT platforms.
* Own vendor onboarding, budgets, contracts, and renewals. In partnership with the Cybersecurity and Legal teams, set permissible-use, privacy, and access standards so tools are used lawfully and consistently.

**Location & Travel**
---------------------

**This role will be based in one of the Whatnot hubs - NYC, San Francisco, Los Angeles with a preference for candidates in New York City. The successful candidate must live within commuting distance of their hub location. Expected in-office cadence: ~2 days per week. This role will be expected to occasionally respond to urgent security incidents outside of normal work hours and will include periodic travel (~10%).**

**You**
-------

Curious about who thrives at Whatnot? We’ve found that embodying a low ego, growth mindset, and high-impact drive goes a long way here.

We’re looking for someone who’s passionate about keeping people safe while enabling the business to thrive. You bring both a deep skillset and empathy to your work, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and lead with calm, informed confidence.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* 7+ years of experience in corporate or government investigations and protective intelligence.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end investigations, including workplace violence, insider risk, and external threats.
* Experience building/vibe-coding purpose built tooling with AI (we use Claude most prominently at Whatnot).
* Deep familiarity with the investigative and intelligence tool landscape (for example Clear, OSINT and social media monitoring platforms, and case management platforms like Ontic), and the ability to articulate which tools are most valuable for this body of work and why.
* Sound judgment on when a concerning behavior warrants escalation, intervention, or law enforcement engagement.
* Strong understanding of permissible use, privacy, and data-handling requirements.

Summary
  
  
Apple is seeking an experienced engineering program manager for the Apple Services Engineering (ASE) | iCloud organization. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to drive and contribute to the extraordinary services and products of iCloud. You will partner with teams whose mission is to build, maintain, and scale the platform and product layer of Apple’s most critical cloud services in China. Your work will focus at the intersection of infrastructure, platform services, features, reliability, scalability, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance. Your work will focus on strategic leadership for all programs and work across iCloud in China. You will define the overarching program vision, drive key initiatives from planning through delivery, and maintain a clear, end-to-end view of how the many efforts across these data centers fit together, including their dependencies, risks, and priorities. Your work will span infrastructure, services, features, reliability, scalability, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance, so you will have the opportunity to partner widely across Apple with engineering teams, operations, security, legal, and business leadership. You will be responsible for identifying, planning, and delivering critical outcomes by autonomously engaging a broad set of stakeholders, communicating program status and strategy to executives, and defining and implementing standard processes that improve our operational efficiency while upholding Apple's high standards for privacy, security, and user experience.
  
  
Description
  
  
Description Technically curious you will autonomously lead projects of varying scale and complexity with cross-functional, geographically dispersed engineering teams with only consultative direction from leadership. You will influence and drive delivery from design to launch. Ensuring clarity, and establish expectations for services requested, while developing and executing processes, frameworks, metrics, and project plans, and defining scope, schedule, deliverables, and resources. * Able to think critically and creatively, identify risks, and drive execution across multiple teams to remediate them..

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Preferred Qualifications
* Experience of working on regulatory compliance initiatives, particularly China
* Strong technical proficiency in client/server product development. Past programming experience is a bonus.
* Experience leading large, complex programs, from requirements gathering and collaboration with teams through software development and release qualification, while maintaining a high bar for quality
* Experience managing cross-org dependencies across multiple engineering teams
* Experience with Supply chain and HW forecasting

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

#### **SR. SECURITY ANALYST, THIRD PARTY RISK MANAGEMENT**

We are seeking a mid-to-senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) professional focused on third-party risk management (TPRM) to own and scale our vendor risk program as SpaceXSI grows. This role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity GRC, vendor management, and procurement: you will assess the full range of third parties the company depends on — software and SaaS providers, cloud and infrastructure partners, AI model and data providers, professional services firms, and other suppliers — from intake and due diligence through ongoing monitoring and offboarding. The ideal candidate brings a cybersecurity and GRC perspective — fluent in how cloud services, identity and access management, encryption, data flows, and AI/LLM systems actually work in production — and can translate assessment findings into clear, risk-based decisions on residual risk and compensating controls rather than simply documenting issues. You will collaborate across procurement, legal, security, privacy, engineering, and business owners to keep third-party risk clear, proportionate, and actionable across enterprise, commercial, and public-sector environments.

#### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own the end-to-end third-party risk lifecycle — intake, inherent risk tiering, due diligence, risk decisioning, contracting support, ongoing monitoring, and offboarding — for vendors and partners across the company
* Design and maintain the risk-tiering methodology and inherent risk questionnaire based on data sensitivity, system and network access, business criticality, and regulatory exposure, so that assessment depth matches actual risk and lower-risk vendors move quickly
* Conduct security, privacy, and business due diligence: issue and review security questionnaires (e.g., SIG, CAIQ, custom assessments), evaluate architecture diagrams and data flows, run follow-up sessions with vendor security teams, and coordinate business checks such as corporate registration, reputational review, and insurance coverage with cross-functional partners
* Critically review independent assurance reports and security documentation, including SOC 1/SOC 2 Type II reports, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certificates and Statements of Applicability, penetration test and vulnerability summaries, and bridge letters. Evaluate scope, carve-outs, exceptions, and complementary user entity controls (CUECs) that SpaceXSI must operate
* Translate findings into clear risk decisions: weigh residual risk and compensating controls, recommend approval, conditional approval, or rejection, and document risk exceptions and risk acceptances with clear rationale, owners, and expiration dates
* Partner with Legal and Procurement to define and negotiate contract security terms, including security and data protection exhibits, DPAs, breach notification, right-to-audit, sub-processor clauses, and data retention and deletion requirements, and ensure SpaceXSI's compliance obligations flow down to vendors and sub-processors
* Assess the risk of AI vendors and AI-enabled services, including model and data handling, training-data use and boundaries, prompt and output controls, data residency, and alignment with AI governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act)
* Oversee fourth parties and sub-processors: map critical downstream dependencies, track sub-processor changes, and assess concentration, business continuity, and supply-chain risk for critical vendors
* Run continuous monitoring of the vendor population using security ratings, breach and threat intelligence, certification expirations, and tier-based reassessment cadences, and lead third-party response when a vendor has a security incident
* Maintain the third-party risk register and track issues, findings, and remediation plans with vendors and internal owners through to closure, with defined SLAs and escalation paths
* Operate and extend GRC platforms (e.g., Vanta) as the system of record for vendor inventory, assessments, and evidence; use automation, scripting, low-code, and AI-assisted workflows to streamline intake, tiering, questionnaire review, evidence collection, and reassessment
* Develop and maintain TPRM policies, standards, procedures, and runbooks that align with SpaceXSI's control environment and frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and NIST CSF / SP 800-53, and support internal and external audits with third-party evidence
* Create and present concise reporting on vendor risk posture, program health, open findings, high-risk vendors, and emerging third-party risk themes to GRC, Security, and business leadership, and guide business owners on TPRM requirements and expectations

This role ensures production schedules are established, maintained, and achieved while serving as the primary interface between internal operations and external customers.

* Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive Program Management Plans for additive manufacturing programs

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

**Job Summary**

**Position Overview**

Palo Alto Networks is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager II to lead critical, strategic engineering initiatives within our Network Security (NetSec) organization. * **Enterprise AI Data Governance & Cataloguing Platform:** Lead the strategic engineering roadmap for AI-driven data governance and cataloguing, navigating fluid compliance standards, unstructured data security, and complex intangible requirements with data-driven decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Multi-Program Leadership & Ownership:** Own the execution of multiple highly complex engineering programs from inception through release. Identify dependencies, resolve inter-organizational ambiguities, and solve cross-product challenges creatively.
* **Systems Thinking & Process Optimization:** Act as a 'Systems Thinker' to drive process change across the NetSec organization. Define product development planning processes, select program management tools, and implement metrics dashboards/KPIs to measure program progress, product quality, and operational efficiency.
* **Technical & Architectural Influence:** Influence technical design and decision-making for multiple programs by understanding underlying business use cases, system details, and cross-functional trade-offs.
* **Product Completeness & Quality:** Ensure end-to-end completeness in product development and delivery across all collaborating functional areas (Engineering, QA, PLM, Operations, and Cloud Infrastructure).
* **AI Transformation & Mentorship:** Lead the organization-wide shift toward advanced AI integration. Introduce novel AI tools/frameworks, mentor lower-level TPMs on AI workflows, and quantify organizational productivity gains and time savings.
* **Cross-Product Influence & Stakeholder Engagement:** Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for your product areas. Influence peers across teams and organizations to solve cross-functional and cross-product challenges, and present strategic process decisions to executive leadership.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

**Candidate Qualifications & Core Competencies**

* **Experience:** 10+ years of technical program management experience leading large-scale software, cloud security, or enterprise networking programs.
* **Scope & Ownership:** Demonstrated track record of owning multiple high-complexity programs simultaneously across collaborating product divisions.
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep technical understanding of Network Security, Cloud Firewalls, Distributed Runtime Security Agents, or Enterprise AI Data Governance platforms.
* **Systems Leadership:** Proven ability as a 'Systems Thinker'—defining product development processes, managing Jira/Confluence dashboards, and running regular retrospectives for continuous team scaling.

As the Sales Operations Analyst, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the commercial operations of USGBC and GBCI. new_jobs.title: Program Manager (Special Projects)
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the full technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system (ArsenalOS) that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.  
  
MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.  
  
This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

As Program Manager for Special Projects/Triage, you will own the intake-to-execution lifecycle for manufacturing technology requests routed to MDP from ManTech stakeholders. You will scope work, define deliverables, coordinate execution across MDP teams, and ensure every project has explicit scope, timeline, exit criteria, and clear handoff—no open-ended engagements.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own the intake and triage process for manufacturing technology requests from ManTech teams, evaluating requests for fit, feasibility, and alignment with MDP capabilities and priorities.
* Define and maintain clear intake criteria that separate ManTech special projects from standing line-of-effort work, ensuring requests are appropriately scoped and routed.
* Partner with ManTech stakeholders to understand their needs, translate ambiguous requests into well-defined project scopes with explicit deliverables, timelines, and success criteria.

* Coordinate project execution across MDP engineering teams, ensuring special projects are staffed, prioritized appropriately, and delivered on time without disrupting standing initiatives.
* Drive projects from kickoff through delivery and handoff, maintaining transparency with stakeholders on status, risks, blockers, and timeline changes.
* Establish and enforce governance processes that prevent scope creep, ensure accountability, and maintain discipline around project closure and handoff.
* Build and maintain a portfolio view of all active special projects, tracking status, resource allocation, and capacity to take on new requests.
* Facilitate kickoff meetings, status reviews, and retrospectives for special projects, ensuring clear communication and alignment across MDP and ManTech teams.
* Identify patterns in incoming requests that indicate opportunities for platform capabilities, standardized solutions, or process improvements that reduce future special project volume.
* Work with MDP leadership to balance special project demand against standing initiative roadmaps, escalating conflicts and recommending prioritization decisions.
* Document and communicate handoff criteria, transition plans, and ongoing support expectations for completed special projects.
* Build strong working relationships with ManTech stakeholders, establishing trust and credibility as a reliable partner who delivers on commitments.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, or technical program management roles, ideally in fast-paced technology or manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated ability to scope ambiguous requests into well-defined projects with clear deliverables, timelines, and success criteria.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with proven experience managing expectations, negotiating scope, and saying "no" diplomatically when necessary.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional execution across engineering, manufacturing, operations, and business teams without direct management authority.
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and limited resources.

Summary
  
  
Apple is seeking an experienced engineering program manager for the Apple Services Engineering (ASE) | iCloud organization. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to drive and contribute to the extraordinary services and products of iCloud. You will partner with teams whose mission is to build, maintain, and scale the platform and product layer of Apple’s most critical cloud services in China. Your work will focus at the intersection of infrastructure, platform services, features, reliability, scalability, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance. Your work will focus on strategic leadership for all programs and work across iCloud in China. You will define the overarching program vision, drive key initiatives from planning through delivery, and maintain a clear, end-to-end view of how the many efforts across these data centers fit together, including their dependencies, risks, and priorities. Your work will span infrastructure, services, features, reliability, scalability, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance, so you will have the opportunity to partner widely across Apple with engineering teams, operations, security, legal, and business leadership. You will be responsible for identifying, planning, and delivering critical outcomes by autonomously engaging a broad set of stakeholders, communicating program status and strategy to executives, and defining and implementing standard processes that improve our operational efficiency while upholding Apple's high standards for privacy, security, and user experience.
  
  
Description
  
  
Description Technically curious you will autonomously lead projects of varying scale and complexity with cross-functional, geographically dispersed engineering teams with only consultative direction from leadership. You will influence and drive delivery from design to launch. Ensuring clarity, and establish expectations for services requested, while developing and executing processes, frameworks, metrics, and project plans, and defining scope, schedule, deliverables, and resources. You will help teams and leaders make clear, well-informed trade-offs, operating at every level of the organization, from going deep into technical detail with engineers to representing the program to leadership and to partner teams across Apple. Execution is critical, and you will bring the same rigor to how the work gets done as to what gets delivered.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor's/Master's degree or equivalent work experience in project management or cloud engineering.
* 5+ years of experience in program or project management, successfully leading highly cross-functional software development.
* Cloud platform software and infrastructure experience, with working knowledge of software and server delivery, reliability, security, privacy, and compliance review workflows.
* Fluent in software development processes (SDLC). Have personally orchestrated the delivery of multiple significant client/server software products under demanding timelines, managing multiple work streams cross-functionally across a large organization.
* Collaborative engagement and technical empathy for engineers.
* Sound technical foundation, including working knowledge of distributed systems concepts such as load balancing, request routing, capacity planning, and latency, and a highly motivated, self-starting approach.
* Experience as a project lead, able to focus and simplify, balancing the details with goals, priorities, and trade-offs.
* Consistent record in defining, maturing processes and key metrics and executing on them.
* Proven leader who inspires teams, makes sound decisions, and negotiates effectively, with a track record of influencing partners without direct authority.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Ability to filter and distill relevant information for the right audience, with strong presentation skills both in person and in multi-location meetings.
* Able to think critically and creatively, identify risks, and drive execution across multiple teams to remediate them..

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Preferred Qualifications
* Experience of working on regulatory compliance initiatives, particularly China
* Strong technical proficiency in client/server product development. Past programming experience is a bonus.
* Experience leading large, complex programs, from requirements gathering and collaboration with teams through software development and release qualification, while maintaining a high bar for quality
* Experience managing cross-org dependencies across multiple engineering teams
* Experience with Supply chain and HW forecasting

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,500 and $311,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.
